prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Pincoya, the benevolent marine-fertility spirit of Chiloe. Native square PNG at least1024 by1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: One beautiful adult woman with very long BLOND hair, one head, two eyes, two arms and two human legs, NO fish tail. For this illustration she wears a FULLY OPAQUE closed high-neck long-sleeved ankle-length dress; no sheer cloth, visible cleavage or nudity. [pincoya-c02, pincoya-c10]
MOMENT: Turn into a sweeping dance facing the sea, arms and fully clothed body in clear motion, head turning toward camera.
POWER: Abundant fish gather physically in the water beside her sea-facing dance, reflecting the documented sign of plentiful fish and her marine fertility; no glowing ribbons. [pincoya-c03, pincoya-c04, pincoya-c11]
SCALE & CAMERA: extremely close low camera and foreshortening, no invented giant size, no tiny people as size references; distinguishing anatomy readable at200px.
LIGHT & WEATHER: Single copper sunset source along blond hair and opaque fabric, strong real ocean spray.
SURFACE: tactile organic fur, skin, feather, scales, wet wood or opaque cloth corresponding to the documented subject, never plastic.
SETTING: The Chilotan coast, sea directly in front of her dance. [pincoya-c01, pincoya-c04]
MOOD: reverent overwhelming grace and humanitarian awe; never cute, calm, static or decorative. Dark walnut, antique-gold and parchment palette with one strong accent.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, glyph, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, arms, legs, fingers or attributes; no film, game, anime or comic adaptation; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons. Anatomical counts in this prompt override generic creature associations.
